segments.text: Ok so this is the fixed schema A2UI page for OpenAI Agents, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
So this is the problem, the display flight tool is defined, but no agent is ever built with it, and the flight schema file is never shown.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
This part, the agent itself, wasn't on the page, so I had to add it myself.
Moving on to the demo. The flight card should show the airports, airline and price, but umm, the card shows up with every field empty.
So basically, the page is missing the agent and the schema file, and even with both added the card never gets its data.
That's what's breaking here, kindly have it fixed.
